from: sounds already in the KILLDRUM library

packs.name: DOLLHOUSE
packs.about: Toy-box percussion: plastic drums, xylophone hits, rattles, squeakers, wind-up gear clicks and toy cymbals. Cute on the surface, slightly off underneath.

packs.name: CANDY CANE
packs.about: Sugary one-shots: sparkles, chimes, pops, bubble bursts, bells, swooshes and shiny risers. Bright and playful.

packs.name: RAWS
packs.about: Dry, unprocessed drums: hard kicks, cracking snares, room hits and live breaks. Nothing polished, just raw impact.

packs.name: INSOMNIA
packs.about: Late-night atmosphere: tape hiss, vinyl crackle, room tone, distant traffic, rain on windows and humming fridges. The sound of being awake at 3 am.

packs.name: SLUMBER
packs.about: Hushed, dusty drums: muffled kicks, brushed snares, pillow hits, soft shakers and finger snaps. Sleepy, close and intimate.

packs.name: MELTDOWN
packs.about: Everything distorted: blown-out kicks, crushed snares, overdriven 808 hits, burning impacts and collapsing sub drops. Pushed past the limit.

packs.name: SAWTOOTH
packs.about: Industrial and metallic: grinding metal, chains, machine clanks, screeches, saw blades and factory impacts. Cold, sharp and mechanical.

packs.name: DIGI JUNKY
packs.about: 2000s computer sounds: modem screeches, ringtone blips, error beeps, glitch stutters, bitcrushed hits, buffering loops and old desktop clicks.
